years_since_diagnosis.evidence: Just got hit with this Crohn's diagnosis six months ago.

location.evidence: they found inflammation throughout large intestine.

severity.evidence: Patient is symptomatic (diarrhea, weight loss, urgency) and failing multiple therapies (prednisone, mesalamine, budesonide), suggesting moderate severity.

disease_control.evidence: Patient reports symptoms persist (diarrhea, urgency) and current medication (budesonide) is 'not great'.

treatments.reason_stopped: blood sugars went crazy, cardiologist concerns
treatments.evidence: Started me on prednisone first. Blood sugars went crazy... Cardiologist wasn't happy about steroids
Tried mesalamine after tapering prednisone. Didn't do much.
Now on something called budesonide. It's okay, not great.

encounters.evidence: GI doctor wants to try biologics but I'm hesitant.

status.evidence: GI doctor wants to try biologics but I'm hesitant... Next appointment will discuss options.

barriers.evidence: Already on so many meds... Adding immunosuppressants seems risky. What if I get sick? I help watch my grandkids... They're walking petri dishes.
the cost alone is staggering. We're on Medicare. Coverage is complicated. Donut hole, prior authorizations.

referral_steps_gp_to_prescriber.evidence: Only one GI specialist mentioned as the decision-maker.
